blocks.explanation:
Yeh general letters mein proof hai; is identity ko Pascal ka rule kehte hain.
Plan: left side ke dono terms factorials mein likhein, denominators barabar karein, jama karein, aur aakhir mein \({}^{n+1}C_{r}\) pehchanein. Yeh bilkul Question 12 jaisa kaam hai, bas numbers ki jagah letters hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}C_{r} + {}^{n}C_{r-1}\), jahan \(1 \le r \le n\).
Saabit karna hai: yeh \({}^{n+1}C_{r}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) lagayenge, phir fractions jama karne ka aam tareeqa: pehle denominators ek jaise.

Factorials mein likhein
\[{}^{n}C_{r} = \dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\]
\[{}^{n}C_{r-1} = \dfrac{n!}{(r-1)!\,(n-r+1)!}\]
Kyun: Doosre term mein \(r\) ki jagah \(r - 1\) rakha. Neeche \((r-1)!\) aaya aur \((n-(r-1))! = (n-r+1)!\), kyunke minus ke saath bracket kholne par \(-(-1) = +1\).
Dhyan dein: \((n-r-1)!\) likhna aam ghalti hai; sign dhyan se kholein.

Denominators barabar karein
\[\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!} = \dfrac{n!\,(n-r+1)}{r!\,(n-r+1)!}\]
\[\dfrac{n!}{(r-1)!\,(n-r+1)!} = \dfrac{n!\,r}{r!\,(n-r+1)!}\]
Kyun: Pehle term mein \((n-r)!\) ko \((n-r+1)!\) banana hai; \((n-r+1)! = (n-r+1)(n-r)!\), is liye upar neeche \((n-r+1)\) se zarb. Doosre mein \((r-1)!\) ko \(r!\) banana hai; \(r! = r\,(r-1)!\), is liye upar neeche \(r\) se zarb. Value nahi badli, sirf shakal badli.

Fractions jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{n!\,[(n-r+1) + r]}{r!\,(n-r+1)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{n!\,(n+1)}{r!\,(n-r+1)!}\]
Kyun: Denominator ek hai, is liye numerators jama kiye aur \(n!\) common nikala. Bracket mein \(-r\) aur \(+r\) cancel ho kar \(n + 1\) bacha.

\({}^{n+1}C_{r}\) pehchanein
\[= \dfrac{(n+1)!}{r!\,(n+1-r)!}\]
\[= {}^{n+1}C_{r} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Factorial ki definition se \((n+1) \cdot n! = (n+1)!\). Aur \(n - r + 1\) ko \((n+1) - r\) likh sakte hain. Ab yeh bilkul \(n+1\) cheezon mein se \(r\) chunne ka formula hai.

Tasdeeq: numbers se (\(n = 5\), \(r = 2\))
\[{}^{5}C_{2} + {}^{5}C_{1} = 10 + 5 = 15\]
\[{}^{6}C_{2} = 15 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Chhoti misaal mein identity sahi nikli. Is ka matlab bhi samjhein: \(n+1\) logon mein se \(r\) chunne hain. Ek khaas shakhs ko dekhein: jin groups mein woh nahi, woh \({}^{n}C_{r}\) hain; jin mein woh hai, un mein baqi \(r - 1\) log \(n\) mein se chune jate hain, yani \({}^{n}C_{r-1}\). Dono mil kar saare groups.
